description: This file is a service worker script implementing offline caching for a web application, managing cache storage, handling install, activate, and fetch events to provide offline capabilities and cache management.

methods.name: install event handler
methods.description: Handles the service worker installation, opening cache and adding assets.

methods.name: activate event handler
methods.description: Handles activation, deleting old caches and claiming clients.

methods.name: fetch event handler
methods.description: Intercepts fetch requests to serve cached assets or fetch from network with caching logic.
